mainEntity.name: Copyfy or BigSpy: which one is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: It all depends on your need. Copyfy is better for running an e-commerce business from A to Z: product research, store analysis, pages and going live. BigSpy is better if you only want to comb through multi-network ad creatives at a low price. To launch and run a store, Copyfy wins; for pure, cheap ad spying, BigSpy is still solid.

On the sticker price, yes (9$/month against 49€/month). On the real cost of your stack, no: BigSpy only covers multi-network ad spying, so you have to add other subscriptions to launch a store, while Copyfy does the whole job for 49€/month with a 5-day trial and no credit card.

mainEntity.name: Which one has the best product research?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy, without hesitation. Its AI targets winning products directly and analyzes competitor stores, where BigSpy deduces trends from social ads alone. To move fast toward a product to launch, Copyfy's approach is more direct.

For the majority of dropshippers, yes. Copyfy covers product research, competitor analysis, pages and Shopify and WooCommerce integration. BigSpy keeps the edge on entry price and the breadth of its multi-network ad database: if ad spying on a very small budget is your core business, it complements Copyfy well.

mainEntity.name: Can you test these tools for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy offers a 5-day free trial, no credit card, plus a 5-day free trial. BigSpy offers a limited free plan and a 3-day trial at 1 dollar. The simplest is to test Copyfy for free to see whether the suite covers your need.
